summary: Welcome footer 4-style responsive contract final retest after compact-tablet width cap fix. 4 of 5 target viewports PASS. 700px STILL FAILS - shows single-column-stacked (4 rows) instead of expected 2x2 grid. Column width at 700px is 310px which is too wide to fit 2 columns side-by-side in the available 628px grid width. 820px, 930px, 1024px, 1179px all PASS. All regression checks pass.

ui_bugs.issue: At 700px viewport (compact tablet range 560-879px), footer link columns show single-column-stacked layout (4 rows) instead of expected 2x2 grid. Column width is 310px, grid width is 628px. Two 310px columns + 16px gap = 636px which exceeds 628px available width, causing columns to wrap to single column.

action_items: STILL FAILING: 700px shows single-column-stacked instead of 2x2 grid
ROOT CAUSE: compactTabletLinkColumnWidth calculation at line 632-634 produces 310px columns at 700px viewport. Two 310px columns + 16px gap = 636px exceeds the 628px grid width.

FIX NEEDED: Reduce compactTabletLinkColumnWidth for narrower compact tablet viewports (560-750px range) to allow 2 columns to fit side-by-side. Consider: Math.max(184, Math.floor((Math.min(footerContentMaxWidth, 720) - 44) / 2)) or similar adjustment.
critical_code_review_comments: compactTabletLinkColumnWidth formula at line 632-634 needs adjustment for narrower viewports in the 560-750px range to ensure 2x2 layout is achievable
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome footer 4-style responsive contract final retest: (1) 700px FAIL - single-column-stacked instead of 2x2, column width 310px too wide for 628px grid, (2) 820px PASS - 2x2 grid, (3) 930px PASS - 4-column single row, (4) 1024px PASS - 4-column single row, (5) 1179px PASS - 4-column single row. All regression checks pass: no horizontal overflow, centered disclaimer, bottom bar intact.
rca_of_the_issue: At 700px viewport, footerContentMaxWidth calculates to ~664px, and the grid width is 628px. The compactTabletLinkColumnWidth formula: Math.max(184, Math.floor((Math.min(720, footerContentMaxWidth) - 44) / 2)) produces ~310px columns. Two 310px columns + 16px gap = 636px, which exceeds the 628px available grid width, causing flex-wrap to stack columns vertically instead of forming a 2x2 grid.
